Authors and Citation

Authors

  • Daniel P. Smith. Author, maintainer.

  • Melissa O'Neill. Contributor, copyright holder.
    PCG random number generator

  • The scikit-learn developers. Contributor, copyright holder.
    SMACOF (MDS, NMDS), t-SNE, Isomap, PLS-DA and LDA code ported from scikit-learn

  • James Melville. Copyright holder.
    uwot's C++ header library, followed by the UMAP code

  • scikit-bio development team. Contributor, copyright holder.
    phylogenetic tree pruning and node numbering (rpca_phylo()), PCoA biplot scores, BIOENV, the alr and ilr transforms and balances, multiplicative zero replacement, the variance of log ratios, ANCOM, ANCOM-BC and ANCOM-BC2, Dirichlet-multinomial t-tests, and alpha diversity metrics (evenness, coverage, Hill numbers, Renyi and Tsallis entropies, dominance, the Gini index, and the bias-corrected Chao1), from scikit-bio

  • NumPy Developers. Copyright holder.
    numpy's pairwise summation, followed by replace_zeros_mult()

  • Cameron Martino. Contributor, copyright holder.
    'gemelli' robust Aitchison PCA and phylogenetic robust Aitchison PCA

  • Daniel McDonald. Contributor, copyright holder.
    tree shearing and collapsing, following 'iow' (bp)

  • The SciPy developers. Contributor, copyright holder.
    Procrustes analysis and a Nelder-Mead minimiser, following SciPy

  • Nathan Lemoine. Contributor, copyright holder.
    SIMPER, following 'ecopy'

  • Wright State University. Contributor, copyright holder.
    OPLS-DA, from 'pyopls'

  • Raes Lab. Contributor, copyright holder.
    quantitative microbiome profiling, following 'QMP.R'

  • Huang Lin. Contributor, copyright holder.
    ANCOM-BC and ANCOM-BC2 ('ANCOMBC'), via scikit-bio's port

  • ALDEx3 authors. Contributor, copyright holder.
    the scale model and effect sizes of dirmult_ttest(), and dirmult_lm(), following 'ALDEx3'

  • Biota Technology. Contributor, copyright holder.
    the Gibbs sampler of sourcetracker(), from 'SourceTracker2'

  • Benjamin Callahan. Contributor, copyright holder.
    contaminant identification (decontam(), decontam_not()), ported from 'decontam'

  • Nicole Marie Davis. Contributor, copyright holder.
    contaminant identification (decontam(), decontam_not()), ported from 'decontam'

  • Nicola Segata. Contributor, copyright holder.
    LDA effect size biomarker discovery (lefse()), ported from 'LEfSe'

  • Curtis Huttenhower. Contributor, copyright holder.
    LDA effect size biomarker discovery (lefse()), ported from 'LEfSe'

  • ravel-lab. Contributor, copyright holder.
    vaginal community state types (valencia()) and their reference centroids, from 'VALENCIA'

  • Kyle Bittinger. Contributor, copyright holder.
    turnover, nestedness, balanced and gradient components of beta diversity, ported from 'abdiv'

  • Michael Sieber. Contributor, copyright holder.
    the neutral community model fit (neutral_model()), following 'neufit'

  • Siyuan Ma. Contributor.
    MMUPHin batch correction (batch_mmuphin()), ported from 'MMUPHin'

  • Harvard School of Public Health. Copyright holder.
    'MMUPHin', from which batch_mmuphin() is ported

  • sva authors. Contributor, copyright holder.
    ComBat batch correction (batch_combat()), ported from 'sva'

  • Alkek Center for Metagenomics and Microbiome Research. Copyright holder, funder.
